question: What is the meaning of eco-toxicity in relation to essential environmental characteristics?
description: Eco-toxicity refers to the harmful effects of substances on living organisms, including humans, and is one of the predetermined environmental essential characteristics in the context of sustainable construction. It is a critical aspect of life cycle assessment (LCA) and is covered in harmonised technical specifications and European assessment documents. The lack of broad consensus and harmonisation in the LCA community has led to limited inclusion of eco-toxicity-related impacts in LCA calculations, with only a small percentage of chemicals being covered to characterise human toxicity impacts. However, it is an essential characteristic to consider in sustainable construction practices.
